caption:
Not every Torres del Paine day starts at the towers.

Enter through the Sarmiento gate and walk the open steppe, where guanacos are often the first to greet you. It is a quieter side of the park, and a good one to build into a longer route.

Plan your Patagonia trip. Link in bio.
